chunks: The jurisdiction in this province belongs to God. His is the best reward, and His the best requital.

key_terms.لِلَّهِ الْحَقُّ: Belongs to God, the True One

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about divine Wilayah and its reward?
ai.summary: Although the Arabic text is from Surah Al-Kahf (18:44), the concept of Al-Wilayah being exclusively for Allah is central to Shia theology, particularly in establishing the divine right of the Imams as God's deputies. This verse underscores that true authority and its resulting reward are superior to worldly power, a principle often extended to the Ahl al-Bayt in Shia exegesis (Tafsir) as the manifestation of divine Wilayah on earth.
